company.name: Demodesk
company.shortDescription: Demodesk is a sales tech that assists reps live during the call, provides insights into what’s working & automates all scheduling processes
company.description:
Demodesk is a virtual meeting platform built for sales and success. We empower every rep to become a top performer – by guiding sellers in real-time, automating non-selling tasks, engaging customers in the meeting and analyzing insights at scale. 

Demodesk automatically loads the perfect playbook into every customer meeting – guiding reps with the right slides or web apps to present, talk tracks and battle cards on the spot. 

Sales teams can automate non-selling tasks from scheduling, meeting preparation, CRM documentation to follow-up. 

Our breakthrough screen-sharing technology makes meetings truly engaging and lets customers interact with the software during the meeting. 

AI-based insights help sales leaders understand what's happening in the call, understand what works and coach teams in a world where everyone works from anywhere.

Demodesk seamlessly connects with your entire tech stack including G Suite, Microsoft Office, Salesforce, Hubspot, Pipedrive, Gong and many more. 

Leading SaaS companies are using Demodesk to cut down ramp time, increase quota attainment, lift sales productivity, and accelerate growth.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $8,000,000, or 75.47% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $150,000, representing 1.42% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,955,987 to $38,566,087, a 13.05x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
